bio: Co-founder & CTO @KineDexRobotics. Building bimanual manipulation policies for high-mix warehouse kitting. Ex-ETH Zurich ASL.
discovered_via: SEG-01: SEA Embodied AI & Robotics Founders

recent_posts.text: Finally got our diffusion policy inference latency down from 64ms to 18ms on a single Jetson AGX Orin using TensorRT + INT8 calibration—without dropping grasp success rate on deformable polybags (still 93.4% across 1,200 picks).

Week 2 of our live 3PL warehouse pilot in Tuas, Singapore. Biggest lesson: lighting glare off shrink-wrapped pallets breaks standard RGB depth estimation way more than sim predicted. Active stereo + tactile wrist feedback saved us.
